<style>
.timeline-2-list {
	position: relative;
	padding: var(--space-m) 0;
}

.timeline-2-list::after {
	content: '';
	position: absolute;
	width: 2px;
	background: var(--primary-light);
	top: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	left: 50%;
	margin-left: -1px;
}

.timeline-2-card {
	padding: 15px 30px;
	position: relative;
	background: inherit;
	width: 50%;
}

.timeline-2-card:nth-child(odd) {
	left: 0;
}

.timeline-2-card:nth-child(even) {
	left: 50%;
}

.timeline-2-card::after {
	content: '';
	position: absolute;
	width: 16px;
	height: 16px;
	top: calc(50% - 8px);
	right: -8px;
	background: #fff;
	border: 2px solid var(--primary);
	border-radius: 16px;
	z-index: 1;
}

.timeline-2-card:nth-child(even)::after {
	left: -8px;
}

.timeline-2-card::before {
	content: '';
	position: absolute;
	width: 50px;
	height: 2px;
	top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
	right: 8px;
	background: var(--primary);
	z-index: 1;
}

.timeline-2-card:nth-child(even)::before {
	left: 8px;
}

.timeline-2-card .timeline-2-card__date {
	position: absolute;
	display: inline-block;
	top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
	text-align: right;
	font-size: 14px;
	font-weight: bold;
	color: var(--primary-dark);
	text-transform: uppercase;
	letter-spacing: 1px;
	z-index: 1;
}

.timeline-2-card:nth-child(odd) .timeline-2-card__date {
	left: calc(100% + var(--space-m));
}

.timeline-2-card:nth-child(even) .timeline-2-card__date {
	right: calc(100% + var(--space-m));
}

.timeline-2-card .timeline-2-card__icon {
	position: absolute;
	display: inline-block;
	padding: .8rem;
	top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%); 
	border: 2px solid var(--primary);
  border-radius: var(--radius-circle);
	text-align: center;
	font-size: 2.4rem;
	color: var(--primary);
	z-index: 1;
}

.timeline-2-card:nth-child(odd) .timeline-2-card__icon {
	right: 56px;
}

.timeline-2-card:nth-child(even) .timeline-2-card__icon {
	left: 56px;
}

.timeline-2-card .timeline-2-card__content {
	padding: var(--space-m) var(--space-xxl) var(--space-m) var(--space-m);
	background: var(--primary-ultra-light);
	position: relative;
	border-radius: 0 var(--radius-xl) var(--radius-xl) 0;
}

.timeline-2-card:nth-child(even) .timeline-2-card__content {
	padding: var(--space-m) var(--space-m) var(--space-m) var(--space-xxl);
	border-radius: var(--radius-xl) 0 0 var(--radius-xl);
}

.timeline-2-card .timeline-2-card__content h3 {
	margin: 0 0 10px 0;
	font-size: 18px;
	color: var(--primary);
}

.timeline-2-card .timeline-2-card__content p {
	margin: 0;
	font-size: 16px;
	line-height: 22px;
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
	.timeline-2-list::after {
		left: -8px;
	}

	.timeline-2-card {
		width: 100%;
		padding-left: var(--space-xs);
		padding-right: 0px;
	}

	.timeline-2-card:nth-child(even) {
		left: 0%;
	}

	.timeline-2-card:nth-child(odd)::after, 
	.timeline-2-card:nth-child(even)::after {
		left: -16px;
	}

	.timeline-2-card:nth-child(odd)::before,
	.timeline-2-card:nth-child(even)::before {
		left: 0px;
		border-color: transparent #006E51 transparent transparent;
		width: 25px;
	}

	.timeline-2-card:nth-child(odd) .timeline-2-card__date,
	.timeline-2-card:nth-child(even) .timeline-2-card__date {

    position:static;
		font-size: var(--text-s);
    padding-left:var(--space-xxl);
		padding-top: var(--space-xs);
    transform: translateY(0%);
	}

	.timeline-2-card:nth-child(odd) .timeline-2-card__icon,
	.timeline-2-card:nth-child(even) .timeline-2-card__icon {
		right: auto;
		left: 25px;
	}

	.timeline-2-card:nth-child(odd) .timeline-2-card__content,
	.timeline-2-card:nth-child(even) .timeline-2-card__content {
		padding: var(--space-m) var(--space-m) var(--space-m) var(--space-xxl);
		border-radius: 0;
	}
}
</style>
